title: Do_Axis
slide_intent: Keep motion on clear axes so viewers can anticipate where content is going.
strategic_value: The straight image reveal can make a DB layout feel ordered while its components arrive.
demonstration: A woman’s photograph enters on the right beside a dark left panel containing a white DB logo, headline, small copy, and red Schwelle.
practical_value: Use the horizontal image entrance as the approved comparison for the diagonal version in DBV46.

content_islands.name: Image entrance
content_islands.spec: Reveal the photograph on the right along the horizontal axis.

content_islands.name: Message panel
content_islands.spec: Stage the white logo and text above the red bar motif on the dark left side.

reference_purposes.Expression: A woman’s photograph enters on the right beside a dark left panel containing a white DB logo, headline, small copy, and red Schwelle.
reference_purposes.Application: The source provides a playable demonstration of this repeatable sequence: A woman’s photograph enters on the right beside a dark left panel containing a white DB logo, headline, small copy, and red Schwelle.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source says all movement follows clear axes and diagonal animations are never used.
